# SFC - vertex-wise analysis

```{r}
vertices <- readRDS("../data_tidy/vertexwise_sfc.RDS")
vertices$group <- factor(vertices$group, levels = c("CB", "SC"))
setDT(vertices)

pcs       <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")
gradients <- c("G1", "G2", "G3")
combos    <- CJ(pc = pcs, gradient = gradients)

vertices_wide <- dcast(
  as.data.table(vertices),
  subject + vertex + sex + group + age + site + is_lb_match + etiv ~ gradient,
  value.var = c("gradient_value", "pc_score")
)
vertices_wide[, age_c := scale(age, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)]

setnames(vertices_wide,
  old = c("pc_score_G1", "pc_score_G2", "pc_score_G3"),
  new = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")
)
setnames(vertices_wide,
  old = c("gradient_value_G1", "gradient_value_G2", "gradient_value_G3"),
  new = c("G1", "G2", "G3")
)

run_afex_model <- function(data, pc_col, gradient_col) {
  
  dt <- as.data.table(copy(data))
  
  dt[, gradient_score := get(gradient_col)]
  dt[, pc_score       := get(pc_col)]
  
  dt <- dt[!is.na(gradient_score) & !is.na(pc_score)]
  
  cat("  nrow after NA removal:", nrow(dt), "\n")
  cat("  unique subjects:", dt[, uniqueN(subject)], "\n")
  cat("  unique groups:", dt[, uniqueN(group)], "\n")
  cat("  columns:", paste(names(dt), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    mixed(
      gradient_score ~ pc_score * group + age_c + sex + site +
        (1 + pc_score | subject),
      data    = dt,
      method  = "S",
      control = lmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa",
        optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 2e5)),
      check_contrasts = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  ERROR in random slope model:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  random_structure <- "random_slope"
  
  if (is.null(fit) || isSingular(fit$full_model)) {
    cat("  --> falling back to intercept only\n")
    fit <- tryCatch(
      mixed(
        gradient_score ~ pc_score * group + age_c + sex + site +
          (1 | subject),
        data    = dt,
        method  = "S",
        control = lmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 2e5)),
        check_contrasts = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  ERROR in intercept only model:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )
    random_structure <- "intercept_only"
  }
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    cat("  --> both models failed, returning NULL\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  saveRDS(fit, file = paste0("../results/fitvertex_", pc_col, "_", gradient_col, ".RDS"))
  
  anova_table <- as.data.table(anova(fit), keep.rownames = "term")
  anova_table[, `:=`(
    pc               = pc_col,
    gradient         = gradient_col,
    random_structure = random_structure
  )]
  
  emtrends_res <- emtrends(fit$full_model, ~ group, var = "pc_score")
  
  emtrends_dt <- as.data.table(summary(emtrends_res))
  emtrends_dt[, `:=`(
    pc               = pc_col,
    gradient         = gradient_col,
    random_structure = random_structure
  )]
  
  slopes_test <- as.data.table(test(emtrends_res))
  slopes_test[, `:=`(
    pc       = pc_col,
    gradient = gradient_col
  )]
  
  list(
    anova  = anova_table,
    trends = emtrends_dt,
    trends_obj = emtrends_res,
    tests  = slopes_test,
    fit = fit$full_model
  )
}

gradient_cols <- c("G1", "G2", "G3")
pc_cols       <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")

results <- list()

for (g in gradient_cols) {
  for (p in pc_cols) {
    
    cat("Running:", g, "x", p, "\n")
    
    res <- run_afex_model(vertices_wide, p, g)
    
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      results[[paste(g, p, sep = "_")]] <- res
    }
  }
}

anova_all <- rbindlist(lapply(results, `[[`, "anova"), fill = TRUE)
trends_all <- rbindlist(lapply(results, `[[`, "trends"), fill = TRUE)
tests_all  <- rbindlist(lapply(results, `[[`, "tests"),  fill = TRUE)
```

## results

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
anova_all[, p_fdr := p.adjust(`Pr(>F)`, method = "fdr"), by = .(term)]
anova_all[,  significant := p_fdr < 0.05]

results_summary <- anova_all[term == "pc_score" | term == "pc_score:group", ]
results_summary[, p_fdr_fmt := ifelse(
  p_fdr < 0.001,
  "< .001",
  formatC(p_fdr, format = "f", digits = 3)
)]
results_summary
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

pc_cols       <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")
gradient_cols <- c("G1",  "G2",  "G3")

pred_data_list       <- list()
line_data_list       <- list()
subject_slopes_list  <- list()
group_slopes_ci_list <- list()
pred_data_pooled_list <- list()
group_slopes_ci_pooled_list <- list()

for (g in gradient_cols) {
  for (p in pc_cols) {
    key <- paste(g, p, sep = "_")
    res <- results[[key]]
    if (is.null(res))
      next
    
    fit              <- res$fit
    random_structure <- unique(res$trends$random_structure)
    
    # ── Get reference levels from the fitted model directly ─────────────────
    mf        <- model.frame(fit)
    sex_ref   <- levels(mf$sex)[1]
    site_ref  <- levels(mf$site)[1]
    
    # ── PC score range ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    pc_range <- range(mf$pc_score, na.rm = TRUE)
    pc_seq   <- seq(pc_range[1], pc_range[2], length.out = 80)
    
    # ── Group-level predictions via emmeans ──────────────────────────────────
    em <- emmeans(fit,
                  ~ pc_score * group,
                  at = list(
                    pc_score = pc_seq,
                    age_c    = 0,
                    sex      = sex_ref,
                    site     = site_ref
                  ))
    
    pd            <- as.data.frame(summary(em))
    pd$pc         <- p
    pd$gradient   <- g
    names(pd)[names(pd) == "emmean"]    <- "fitted"
    names(pd)[names(pd) == "lower.CL"] <- "lower.CL"
    names(pd)[names(pd) == "upper.CL"] <- "upper.CL"
    pred_data_list[[key]] <- pd
    
    # ── Pooled predictions (collapsing across group, for non-sig interactions) ──
    # Pooled predictions — average over group from the already-computed em object
    em_pooled   <- emmeans(em, ~ pc_score)
    pd_pooled   <- as.data.frame(summary(em_pooled))
    pd_pooled$pc         <- p
    pd_pooled$gradient   <- g
    pd_pooled$group      <- "pooled"
    names(pd_pooled)[names(pd_pooled) == "emmean"]    <- "fitted"
    names(pd_pooled)[names(pd_pooled) == "lower.CL"]  <- "lower.CL"
    names(pd_pooled)[names(pd_pooled) == "upper.CL"]  <- "upper.CL"
    names(pd_pooled)[names(pd_pooled) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "lower.CL"
    names(pd_pooled)[names(pd_pooled) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "upper.CL"
    pred_data_pooled_list[[key]] <- pd_pooled
    
    # ── Per-subject slopes and lines ─────────────────────────────────────────
    re_all    <- ranef(fit)$subject
    re_cols   <- names(re_all)
    fe        <- fixef(fit)
    fe_slope  <- fe["pc_score"]
    fe_int    <- fe["(Intercept)"]
    
    has_int_re   <- "(Intercept)" %in% re_cols
    has_slope_re <- "pc_score"    %in% re_cols
    
    re_dt <- as.data.frame(re_all)
    re_dt$subject <- rownames(re_all)
    
    # Merge group info from model frame
    subj_info <- unique(mf[, c("subject", "group"), drop = FALSE])
    # Note: 'subject' may not be in model frame if it was only in grouping —
    # pull from vertices_wide instead if needed
    if (!"subject" %in% names(subj_info)) {
      subj_info <- unique(vertices_wide[, .(subject, group)])
      subj_info <- as.data.frame(subj_info)
    }
    
    re_dt <- merge(re_dt, subj_info, by = "subject")
    
    re_dt$subj_int   <- fe_int   + if (has_int_re)
      re_dt[["(Intercept)"]]
    else
      0
    re_dt$subj_slope <- fe_slope + if (has_slope_re)
      re_dt[["pc_score"]]
    else
      0
    
    x_min <- pc_range[1]
    x_max <- pc_range[2]
    
    ld <- data.frame(
      subject  = re_dt$subject,
      group    = re_dt$group,
      x_min    = x_min,
      x_max    = x_max,
      y_min    = re_dt$subj_int + re_dt$subj_slope * x_min,
      y_max    = re_dt$subj_int + re_dt$subj_slope * x_max,
      pc       = p,
      gradient = g
    )
    line_data_list[[key]] <- ld
    
    # ── Group slopes + CIs from stored emtrends ──────────────────────────────
    gci <- as.data.frame(res$trends)
    
    # Handle both possible CI column name conventions
    if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(gci)) {
      names(gci)[names(gci) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "slope_lower"
      names(gci)[names(gci) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "slope_upper"
    } else {
      names(gci)[names(gci) == "lower.CL"]  <- "slope_lower"
      names(gci)[names(gci) == "upper.CL"]  <- "slope_upper"
    }
    names(gci)[names(gci) == "pc_score.trend"] <- "slope"
    
    if (!"pc" %in% names(gci))
      gci$pc       <- p
    if (!"gradient" %in% names(gci))
      gci$gradient <- g
    if (!"random_structure" %in% names(gci))
      gci$random_structure <- random_structure
    
    # ── Standardise to beta weights ──────────────────────────────────────────
    sd_pc       <- sd(mf$pc_score,       na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_gradient <- sd(mf$gradient_score, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    group_slopes_ci_list[[key]] <- gci[, c(
      "group",
      "slope",
      "slope_lower",
      "slope_upper",
      "pc",
      "gradient",
      "random_structure"
    )]
    
    # ── Pooled slope (collapsing across group) ───────────────────────────────
    trends_pooled <- emmeans(res$trends_obj, ~ 1, component = "trend")
    gci_pooled    <- as.data.frame(summary(trends_pooled))
    
    gci_pooled <- as.data.frame(trends_pooled)
    names(gci_pooled)[names(gci_pooled) == "pc_score.trend"] <- "slope"
    if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(gci_pooled)) {
      names(gci_pooled)[names(gci_pooled) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "slope_lower"
      names(gci_pooled)[names(gci_pooled) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "slope_upper"
    } else {
      names(gci_pooled)[names(gci_pooled) == "lower.CL"]  <- "slope_lower"
      names(gci_pooled)[names(gci_pooled) == "upper.CL"]  <- "slope_upper"
    }
    gci_pooled$group    <- "pooled"
    gci_pooled$pc       <- p
    gci_pooled$gradient <- g
    group_slopes_ci_pooled_list[[key]] <- gci_pooled[, c(
      "group", "slope", "slope_lower", "slope_upper", "pc", "gradient"
    )]
  }
}

# ── Combine — use data.frame throughout to avoid ggplot2/data.table issues ───
pred_data       <- do.call(rbind, pred_data_list)
line_data       <- do.call(rbind, line_data_list)
pred_data_pooled <- do.call(rbind, pred_data_pooled_list)
class(pred_data_pooled) <- "data.frame"
group_slopes_ci_pooled <- do.call(rbind, group_slopes_ci_pooled_list)

# subject_slopes  <- do.call(rbind, subject_slopes_list)
group_slopes_ci <- do.call(rbind, group_slopes_ci_list)

# ── Fix CI column names in pred_data ─────────────────────────────────────────
names(pred_data)[names(pred_data) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "lower.CL"
names(pred_data)[names(pred_data) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "upper.CL"

# Sanity check
cat("pred_data cols:      ", paste(names(pred_data),       collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("line_data cols:      ", paste(names(line_data),        collapse = ", "), "\n")
# cat("subject_slopes cols: ", paste(names(subject_slopes),  collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("group_slopes_ci cols:", paste(names(group_slopes_ci), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("line_data rows:", nrow(line_data), "\n")

```


## Figure 6C

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LABELS, COLOURS, ANNOTATION DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Extract whether the group interaction is significant for each PC × gradient
sig_lookup <- results_summary[term == "pc_score:group", 
                               setNames(significant, paste0(pc, "_", gradient))]

group_colors <- c(CB = "#43BF71", SC = "#440154")

pc_labels <- c(PC1 = "PC1", PC2 = "PC2", PC3 = "PC3")
gradient_labels <- c(G1 = "Gradient 1", G2 = "Gradient 2", G3 = "Gradient 3")

# ── Morphological extreme annotations (left/right of slope panels) ───────────
annot_left <- data.frame(
  pc       = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"),
  gradient = "G1",
  x        = -Inf,
  y        = Inf,
  label    = c(
    "low volume\nthin\nconcave\nsulci",
    "convex\ngyri",
    "small"
  )
)

annot_right <- data.frame(
  pc       = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"),
  gradient = "G1",
  x        = Inf,
  y        = Inf,
  label    = c(
    "high volume\nthick\nconvex\ngyri",
    "concave\nsulci",
    "large"
  )
)

# ── Gradient axis annotations (rotated, left-column panels only) ─────────────
# One pair per gradient row, placed at y corners of the slope panel
annot_gradient <- data.frame(
  pc       = "PC1",
  gradient = c("G1", "G1", "G2", "G2", "G3", "G3"),
  x        = -Inf,
  y        = c(-Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf),
  label    = c(
    "high-level",    "low-level",
    "peripheral",  "foveal",
    "ventral",     "dorsal"
  )
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ASSEMBLE FULL FIGURE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

pc_list       <- pc_cols        # c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")
gradient_list <- gradient_cols  # c("G1",  "G2",  "G3")

panel_list <- list()

# calculate y-limits for plotting with same y-axis
y_limits <- lapply(setNames(gradient_list, gradient_list), function(g) {
  pd_g <- pred_data[pred_data$gradient == g, ]
  c(min(pd_g$lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(pd_g$upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE))
})

y_limits_dot <- lapply(setNames(gradient_list, gradient_list), function(g) {
  gci_g <- group_slopes_ci[group_slopes_ci$gradient == g, ]
  c(min(gci_g$slope_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(gci_g$slope_upper, na.rm = TRUE))
})

sig_interaction <- results_summary[term == "pc_score:group", .(pc, gradient, sig_interaction = significant)]
sig_main        <- results_summary[term == "pc_score",       .(pc, gradient, sig_main = significant)]

slope_state <- merge(sig_interaction, sig_main, by = c("pc", "gradient"))
slope_state[, plot_mode := fcase(
  sig_interaction == TRUE, "by_group",
  sig_main == TRUE,        "pooled",
  default =                "flat"
)]

mode_lookup <- setNames(slope_state$plot_mode, paste0(slope_state$pc, "_", slope_state$gradient))

for (gi in seq_along(gradient_list)) {
  grad          <- gradient_list[gi]
  is_top_row    <- gi == 1
  
  for (pi in seq_along(pc_list)) {
    pc_col        <- pc_list[pi]
    is_left_col   <- pi == 1
    is_bottom_row <- gi == length(gradient_list)
    is_last_pc    <- pi == length(pc_list)
    
    panel_list[[length(panel_list) + 1]] <- make_slope_panel(
      pc_col,
      grad,
      show_y_axis    = TRUE,
      show_x_axis    = is_bottom_row,
      show_strip_top = is_top_row,
      y_limits       = y_limits[[grad]],
      plot_mode      = mode_lookup[paste0(pc_col, "_", grad)]
    )
    
    panel_list[[length(panel_list) + 1]] <- make_dot_panel(
      pc_col,
      grad,
      show_strip_top     = is_top_row,
      # large_right_margin = !is_last_pc,
      large_right_margin = FALSE,
      y_limits           = y_limits_dot,
      plot_mode      = mode_lookup[paste0(pc_col, "_", grad)]
    )
  }
}

col_widths <- rep(c(3, 1), length(pc_list))
n_rows     <- length(gradient_list)
n_cols     <- length(pc_list) * 2

final_plot <- Reduce(`+`, panel_list) +
  plot_layout(
    nrow   = n_rows,
    ncol   = n_cols,
    widths = col_widths,
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

final_plot
```
